title_sq: SHESIM APARTAMENT 2+1+2 ME OBORR PRIVAT NE REZIDENCEN "PARK HOUSES" , MJULL-BATHORE, TIRANE.

 Park House Residences garanton standarde të larta ndërtimi, qetësi, siguri dhe ambiente të kuruara gjelbërimi, duke e bërë këtë pronë zgjedhjen perfekte për një stil jetese ekskluziv ose një investim me vlerë afatgjatë.
Për më shumë informacion, ju lutem më kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 WITH PRIVATE YARD IN "PARK HOUSES" RESIDENCE, MJULL-BATHORE, TIRANA.

Elegant and functional organization: • Large-sized living room & open space kitchen, with direct access to the courtyard • 2 comfortable bedrooms, designed for maximum privacy, rooms matrimonial with built-in wardrobe and toilet. • 2 contemporary toilets • Distributive corridor with perfect division of premises Areas of premises: • Net area: 120.56 m² • Gross area: 142.26 m² • Courtyard / private veranda: 61.70 m² • Total area: 203.96 m² The apartment benefits from natural lighting throughout the day, regular layout and harmonious connection between spaces internal and external ones. Park House Residences guarantees high construction standards, tranquility, security and manicured green surroundings, making this property the perfect choice for an exclusive lifestyle or a long-term value investment. For more information, please contact me.
